map.由零件变差与测量误差求可区分类别数 使用指南: Number of distinct categories from part variation and measurement error guide
map.输入零件间变差 PV 与测量系统误差 GRR，按 NDC = 1.41 × PV: Enter part-to-part variation PV and measurement system error GRR to get the number of distinct part categories via NDC = 1.41 x PV / GRR. Used to judge whether the measurement system can tell different parts apart: NDC >= 5 counts as effective.
map.输入零件间变差 PV 与测量系统误差 GRR，求 NDC。: Enter part-to-part variation PV and measurement system error GRR to get NDC.
map.：NDC = 1.41*(PV/GRR)。例：过程变异 PV=0.02、GRR=: : NDC = 1.41*(PV/GRR). Example: with process variation PV=0.02 and GRR=0.0028, NDC = 1.41*7.14, about 10.
map.：NDC=1.41×6.5/0.8=11.46，远大于 5，说明该测量系统足以分: : NDC = 1.41 x 6.5/0.8 = 11.46, well above 5, meaning this measurement system can resolve the real differences between parts.
map.由测量标准差与公差带求精度公差比: Compute the precision-to-tolerance ratio from measurement standard deviation and tolerance band
map.由标准不确定度与测得值求相对不确定度: Compute relative uncertainty from standard uncertainty and the measured value
map.NDC≥5 量具足够分辨过程变异。: NDC >= 5 means the gauge can adequately resolve process variation.
map.需提高分辨率或换量具。: Raise the resolution or change the gauge.
